items: Handouts: View opens the handout in a reader docked on half of the screen on a computer (full screen on a phone), like in the Question Bank.
The left menu can be collapsed to icons with the new menu icon at its top; every page now has the same left menu, including Tests.

Downloaded question papers now show the maths properly (it showed raw formulas before). The Adobe icons are replaced by plain download, document, slides, print and share icons. On each paper there is a share icon: Download PDF, Share PDF, or Copy link to this page.
JEE Main important dates are updated to the new NTA 2027 schedule (Session 1: 20 to 28 January 2027, Session 2: 2 to 7 April 2027) and the countdown now runs to 20 January 2027.
New Resources page: Paper Wise Analysis, with the L1, L2, L3 questions, overall toughness and most-asked chapters of every JEE Main paper, and year-wise averages.
All Maths menu items moved into Resources. Pages now link to each other where it helps.

Exam pages ("<Exam>: Everything you should know") are tidied: repeated content is removed and the page now reads in order: countdown, overview, paper pattern, important dates, step-by-step timeline, safe scores, registration numbers, fees, seats and colleges, with one "On this page" list at the top.
KCET logo: now shows the left logo (KEA).

The four Question Bank overview items now open the real Question Bank panels (Question Counts, Chapter-wise Count, Syllabus Priority, Chapter Weightage) as a pop-up inside the Dashboard, with a cross at the top right.
My Performance lists only tests you started or submitted; a test you never started is not shown or counted. (Needs the database file.)
The admin can stay signed in on many devices at once. (Needs the database file.)
Previous Year Papers: each paper says "Open Instructions and Start" and has a PDF button for the question paper.
The left menu now has Tests after DPPs, with Handouts and Tests lit when you are there; the Tests page uses the same left menu.
Level names: Confidence Booster (Level 1), Balanced (Level 2), Rank Booster (Level 3).
Every filter option shows its count, Question type is now also a drop-down, the export box is laid out properly, Report an error is red, and the KCET logo shows the Karnataka emblem.

The Question Bank overview items (Question Counts, Chapter-wise Count, Syllabus Priority, Chapter Weightage) now open as a pop-up inside the Dashboard, with a cross at the top right, instead of taking you to the Question Bank.

New "Special picks" carousel on the Dashboard home: Repeated questions, Sure-shot questions, Mix-breed questions (concepts of 3 or more chapters), Easiest JEE Advanced and Toughest JEE Main. Each opens its own question list.
Fixed the Your progress and Recent tests blocks being wider than the screen on phones.
The Dashboard menu item now opens inside the page, without reloading everything, like the other menu items. It also looks the same as the others now.

A new, more professional Dashboard home: a greeting banner with your numbers, countdown cards for JEE Main and JEE Advanced, six practice cards (PYQs, Non-PYQs, DPPs, Tests, Handouts, Bookmarks), your progress and your recent tests.

Exams: each exam page is now "<Exam>: Everything you should know". The countdown is at the very top, followed by the important dates, safe scores and cutoffs, and the full exam guide (pattern, fees, seats, colleges). The separate guide, safe-scores and dates pages are gone; old links still work.
JEE Main 2027 Session 1 is on 21 January 2027, and the JEE Main countdown now counts down to it.
Resources now has just two pages: Questions Analysis ("<Exam>: Math PYQs, DPPs Analysis", with the chapter-wise and year-wise analysis for every exam) and Important exams after Class 12.
The Exams menu no longer lists Safe scores and Important exams. The countdown note is easier to read, and the first column of the cutoff tables is narrower on phones.
An open question now shows just the question and its options. The level tag, the subtopic and type tags, the Collapse button and the hint line are gone (tap the question header to close it).
The three-line menu is tidier and also shows the Marking scheme of that question (for example +4 / −1, with partial marks where they apply).
Options no longer turn blue when tapped again on a phone.
Dashboard question lists: only 20 questions per page, with page numbers at the bottom.

The bookmark icon at the top right of each question is now a three-line menu with the subtopic, type and level of the question, Bookmark, and Report an error. The Important and Show answer buttons and the question code are gone.

Tap an option to check your answer: green with a tick if right, red with a cross if wrong (the right option is then shown in green). Numerical questions have a box to type the answer and a Check button.
An open question now has a coloured header with a clear Collapse button.
Fixed the word "null" showing under some questions, and tidied the filters into a neat grid on phones.

A new export box in the Dashboard lists: Answer key and Explanation switches, Export (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Print, Share), Save as worksheet and Create test. Exactly the questions in the list after your filters are exported.

The Guide (?) and Question Bank overview (bars) buttons are back, and now sit in the top bar of both the Dashboard and the Question Bank. On the Dashboard the Guide opens in place; the overview items open the matching panel in the Question Bank.
Handouts is now a Dashboard page: Class 11 / Class 12 tabs, search, and a card for every handout with View, Download PDF and a black-and-white print copy.
The menu now reads Dashboard, PYQs, DPPs, Tests, Handouts. The big banners on the PYQs and Tests pages are gone.

Tests, My Performance (was Practice Tests & Results), profile, membership, reports, help, and taking a test all open inside the Dashboard. The Question Bank (/qbank) is only for the Question Bank now.

Create Your Practice Test has many more options: exams and year range, practice books, chapters by class, difficulty, question type, skip already-solved questions, order, number, time, marking scheme and a test name, with a live summary.
The Question Bank page now has exactly the same top bar and footer as the Dashboard, and the menu items are no longer underlined.
DPPs: no more underlined text. Clicking BB Ex, Ln DY or Ln Ex now shows the exercises (grouped by chapter) first; pick one to see its questions, or open All questions.
Tests now open inside the Dashboard (same top bar and left menu), not in the Question Bank. The PYPs menu item also opens in the Dashboard.
The Tests banner is smaller, and the PYPs page has the same new look: a short banner and one card per exam.

DPPs now open inside the Dashboard: pick a source (BB Ex, Ln DY, Ln Ex, Cg ill, Cg Ex, Cg DPPs) in the left menu and see its questions straight away, in exercise order. All filters (Chapter, Exercise, Difficulty, Type, Attempt status) sit in one line at the top.
Mixed Practice uses the same layout: sources as tick boxes on the left, filters in one line on top.
No PDF button during an exam any more. After the test, Practice Tests & Results lets you download the paper, the answer key, the explanations, or a short marking scheme and answers sheet.
The ready-made DPP PDF sheets are still available from the ⋯ menu on the DPP page.

A test never starts by itself now: choosing a paper or a test opens its instructions, with the number of questions, time, maximum marks and the marking scheme by question type. The timer starts only when you press Start.

Previous Year Papers now hold every question of the paper (for example KCET 60 of 60, NDA 120 of 120). Matching questions are marked like single-correct ones. A question with no usable answer key, and written answers of the old IIT-JEE papers, are shown but not marked, and their answer appears in the review.
JEE Advanced and IIT-JEE papers show how marks differ by question type (single correct, one or more correct with partial marks, numerical).
All tests are for your own practice: the 'Who is it for?' choice is gone.
New Tests page with the five tests: Previous Year Papers, Chapter Wise Mock, Must Solve / Repeated Questions, Create Your Practice Test and Full Length Mock.
Menu: 'My Tests and Results' is now 'School Tests & Results' (teachers). 'Practice Tests & Results' shows its own count, and the two counts are separate.
The dashboard and the Question Bank now share one top bar and one footer. The menu is Dashboard, DPPs, PYPs, Tests and Handouts on both pages.
PYQs in the menu is now PYPs (previous year papers).
Question Bank moved under the profile icon, at the top of the menu.
Must Solve is removed: its page, its menu item, its downloads and its mentions on the website.

Questions now open inside the dashboard. All PYQs, a topic, a difficulty bucket, Must Do and Bookmarked each show a compact list of 20 questions (more load as you scroll or tap Show more), so pages open fast.

Tap a question to open it: full text, options, Show answer, Full explanation, Others' solutions, Comments, Important and Report an error, with Previous / Next to move along the list. Practice starts at the first question you have not attempted, and Take Test makes a timed test from the list.

Filters: Hide attempted, Years, Attempt status, Difficulty and question type, with the order (year or level). Export, print and share moved into the ⋯ menu, which opens the Question Bank with exactly those questions selected.

The side menu moves one step up as you go deeper: opening a bucket shows Difficulty Wise Qs Buckets (Most Relevant, Beginner, Rank Booster, Advanced, Must Do of the last 5 years), and opening a topic lists the topics. The back arrow returns to the chapter.
The Question Bank (/qbank) is unchanged.
New site menu: a Dashboard button, Exams, Maths and Resources menus, Plans and Help. The page you are on is underlined, and the phone menu has the same items.

Every exam page now has its date and a live countdown. JEE Advanced 2027 is on 23 May 2027. JEE Main shows the NTA schedule for its January and April 2026 sessions (the 2027 dates will follow when NTA announces them).

Each exam page also links to the official information bulletin, and shows safe scores by category and the marks vs percentile vs rank tables with charts for JEE Main, JEE Advanced, KCET, IAT, NDA and CUET-UG.
New pages: CUET-UG (guide, dates, safe scores), Safe scores and cutoffs for all six exams, and Important Mathematics Exams After Class 12.
The Question Bank top bar now has a Dashboard link too.
One device at a time: signing in on a new device signs the account out of the old one, which shows a clear message. Tests in progress stay saved.
Free accounts: PYQs stay free. Practice questions (BB Ex, Ln Ex, Ln DY and the other books) are Premium: they are shown with a lock and are refused by the server to Free accounts.
Install as an app: on Android (Chrome, Install app) and iPhone / iPad (Safari, Share, Add to Home Screen). The site has an app icon, a standalone window and an offline page.
Admin My Students now shows every student of every school, including Google sign-ins who never chose a school or never finished their profile. The first column is a serial number.
Each student has an approval badge: Approved, Not Approved (school chosen, not verified yet) or Unassigned. The School filter comes before Class and has an Unassigned / No School option.
Edit student now shows the student's current school and saves school changes.
Teachers still see dates of birth only for the verified students of their own school.

Emails from unkganit@gmail.com: a welcome email (asking for the school or teacher ID card while the school is pending, with what a student or teacher can already do), a school-changed email, a school-verified email, and a Premium receipt.
The Login pop-up now has a short box saying what you get free when you sign up.

New Tests menu with five ways to start: Create Your Personal Test, Previous Year Actual Exam, Chapterwise Mock Test, Repeated & Sure-Shot Questions and Full-Length Mock. Chapterwise and Full-Length mocks mix PYQs and practice questions (Premium).

Official marking schemes are now stored by exam and year (2027): JEE Main, JEE Advanced (including partial marking in Section 2), KCET, NDA, IAT and CUET. Tests use the real duration and marks of the exam.
Question codes are hidden while you write a test and appear only in the review after you submit.
Download the question paper as a PDF during a test. After a test, Export lets you choose Questions only, Questions + Answer Key, or Questions + Answer Key + Full Explanations.
If the power or internet goes, the timer pauses by itself. Open the test again within 30 hours to carry on; after that it is submitted with your saved answers.
Board-paper written questions (CBSE Class 12, Sections B to E) have an Expand Options button with 8 final answers to choose from.
The Practice Tests & Results page now lists your tests and results; start new tests from Tests.
Every question card now has: Mark as important (bookmark), Comments, Add your own solution, Full explanation, and a caution icon right after it to report an error.
Comments post at once, with no approval. Anyone signed in can comment on any question.
Add your own solution: upload up to 3 images (handwritten or typed). Many people can add solutions to the same question. They show under Others' solutions, next to Full explanation and Comments.
Reporting an error goes only to the admin, in a private Attention list. Students and teachers can no longer see Attention tags or counts.
Avanti teachers now get Download PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Print and Share for questions and sets.
Important questions you mark appear on your dashboard under Bookmarked Qs.

DPPs now open on seven blocks: BB Ex, Ln DY, Ln Ex, Cg ill, Cg Ex, Cg DPPs and Mixed Practice. Pick a chapter and a sheet (for example DY-1 of Ln DY) and download it as a PDF, or download a whole chapter's sheets in one PDF.
The six sheet libraries are part of Premium (Free accounts see them locked). Cg ill, Cg Ex and Cg DPPs say Coming soon until their sheets are added.
Mixed Practice is the existing DPP builder, with a back button to the seven blocks.

Must Solve is rebuilt: the first questions appear straight away, maths is typeset a few questions at a time, filters (chapter, type, level) are remembered, and a new Find box searches by topic, name or code. Selecting questions only counts questions that are still shown.

New dashboard at unkganit.com/dashboard. Start with PYQs or Non-PYQs, pick an exam (JEE Main, JEE Advanced, KCET, NDA, IAT; CUET and CBSE Class 12 are coming), then a chapter. The left menu changes at every step.
Chapter page: your progress, All PYQs, Topic-wise PYQs, Must Do PYQs, Level 1 / 2 / 3 buckets, a one-tap Chapter Test, chapter performance, and year-wise graph and table.
Bookmarked questions and Test History have their own pages. Question lists open in the Question Bank already filtered.
Free accounts see Non-PYQs with a lock; PYQs stay free.
The question bank, DPPs, PYQs, Must Solve and Handouts now live at unkganit.com/qbank. Old /dashboard links open it automatically.
Source names are shorter everywhere: Black Book is BB Ex, Allen Ex is Ln Ex, Allen DY is Ln DY.
"Personal Tests & Results" is now "Practice Tests & Results".
Question AL-11M4-O2-7: the answer is B, C (flag removed).
Search: the old /jee-maths/ pages no longer redirect, so Google stops reporting them as "Page with redirect".
New "Personal Tests & Results" (profile menu) and a "Tests" tab: pick an exam, pick a paper, and the test starts at once with that paper's time and marking. Your result is saved in your own account.
Free accounts can view all questions and solutions and download PDFs of PYQs. A free teacher can make one test link as a trial; more needs Premium.
Only Premium students can take tests made by their school's teachers. Premium teachers send a link to anyone, and the test is live only for the chosen class and batch.
Premium teachers can share a personal test by link with other Premium teachers and see their rank among them (never anyone's report). The admin can open a test for all teachers or all students.
Teachers can no longer add students. Students register themselves and choose a school, or "Not in School". Choosing or changing a real school needs admin approval.
New "My School": Premium students and Premium teachers of the same school see each other's basic details.
Role is now read-only. A Free student or teacher can ask the admin to switch role; Premium and Avanti accounts cannot.
Match-the-columns tables in the paper and DPP viewer and in the PDF: the column with the short answers (for example "(1) 1") is now narrow, and the column with the long text gets the room.
Answer options such as "(P)→(2), (Q)→(5), (R)→(3), (S)→(4)" now show one per line (four lines) instead of two columns.
Add teacher: the plan list now shows only Free Teacher, Premium Teacher (until a date) and Avanti Teacher (the "Avanti student" choice is gone).

Admin: Edit teacher and Edit student now have one "Account type" list: Free Student, Free Teacher, Premium Student (1 year plan), Premium Teacher (1 year plan), Avanti Student, Avanti Teacher. Choosing a type also changes the role, so a student who chose Teacher by mistake (or the other way round) can be put right.
Admin can now change a student's school in Edit student.

Teachers can only view their students. Only the admin can edit student details; the Edit button in My Students is now for the admin only. (Needs the updated database file: run supabase/schema.sql once.)

Question Bank PDF: no extra empty space after an equation on its own line; pictures are no longer larger than needed (at most about 300 x 220 pixels); match-the-column tables give more room to the column with the longer text.

Set questions in 11M2 repaired: the two Venn-diagram matching questions (AL-11M2-O3-8 and O3-9) now have properly shaded diagrams and typed sets; the match tables that showed raw bars and dashes now show real tables; garbled formulas (for example "midx", "0orx", "wherey") are corrected in 17 questions.

Question Bank PDF, print and Word files: the question code is now printed in brackets right after the level in the grey line above each question, for example "... · L3 (AL-11M1-O3-9)" (it is no longer after the question).
Questions with several parts that list their own options: (A) (B) (C) (D) of each part now sit in one row.
Match-the-columns questions with Roman numerals (I), (II), (III), (IV) in List I now get one table row per item (before, all four sat in the first row).
Questions with many parts, such as (i) to (xvi), are set in 2 or 3 columns reading across row by row: (i) (ii) (iii), then (iv) (v) (vi). Answer options (A) to (D) are never mistaken for parts.
Question Bank PDF, print and Word files now show the question code, for example [AL-11M1-DY10-17], after each question.

Question Bank PDF: a question with many lettered parts, such as (i) to (xvi), is now set in 2 or 3 columns with room between the lines, so the parts no longer overlap and the question takes less space.

Two questions corrected: "x + y = 2 and x³ + y³ = 56" is now written as a system like the one before it ("Find x and y"), and the set A = {(x,y) | xy = 8 and x,y ∈ Z} showed broken text and now reads properly.

Question Bank PDF export: pages no longer cut off a question, its options or a table at the bottom. The pages are now planned with the same measurements the page pictures use, with a little spare room at the bottom of every page.
94 bare questions that were only an equation or an inequality now start with "Solve:", and 12 systems of equations start with "Find x and y:".

Google sign-in now returns to unkganit.com (the address that was already set up in the login service) and is then sent on to the dashboard automatically. Before, it asked to return straight to unkganit.com/dashboard, which could end in "This site can't be reached" for people signing in for the first time.
Questions with formulas on their own line (for example the IAT papers) no longer have large empty gaps after each formula, in the papers, DPPs and the test window.
Answer options with a long formula (for example with "...") are shown one per line, not in two columns.
Exported test papers show no question code or exam name after the questions.
The "Syllabus Priority" button is removed from the sidebar of the public pages (it is still in the menu at the top).
The teachers' chat is removed everywhere (the chat button, the code, the plan lists and the privacy text).

Dashboard loading: if a request fails once because of a slow or dropped connection, the dashboard now tries again by itself (your profile, and the main script) instead of asking you to refresh. The sign-in is also checked a second time before sending you to the login page.
My Tests menu: Rename now has its own icon (a text icon), Deactivate is shown in red and Activate in green. Rename in Saved worksheets uses the new icon too.

Exported test papers: under the test name there is now one line with the class, the batch and the school, separated by dots, for example "11 · JEE · All schools". If the test is for one school, its name is shown instead of "All schools".
Exported test papers: the details line now uses the full width with proper labels spread evenly: Questions, Time, Maximum marks, Marking (+/-) and Date.
Exported test papers: nothing under the test name now. Layout: title, blue line, one line with the details (questions, time, maximum marks, +/- marking, date), another blue line, then the questions.

Exported test papers: the line under the test name now shows the details in one line (questions, time, maximum marks, +/- marking and the date the test was created), for example "25 Qs · 60 min · Max marks 100 · +4/−1 · 17 Nov 2026". "Test paper" stays only in the top-right badge.
My Tests: a PDF, Word or PowerPoint exported from a test now shows the test name with "Test paper" in the header (it said "Worksheet" before). Saved worksheets still say "Worksheet".

My Tests and Results: the three-dots button is now always at the top right of the test card, whatever the title length. Preview and Deactivate/Activate moved into that menu (Preview, Edit, Rename, Deactivate, Delete). The Copy link button is gone: tap the link itself to copy it. Results and Export are on one line.

My Tests and Results: every test card now has an Export button (PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Share PDF, as in Saved worksheets) and a three-dots menu at the top with Edit, Rename and Delete. The separate Edit and Delete buttons are gone from the card.
Question AL-11M1-DY6-4 now starts with "Find x and y:".

Answer key: about 1,080 questions that said "See the solution." now show the real answer, taken from the end of the explanation. Questions with several parts show the answer of every part, for example "(i) 1; (ii) 0; (iii) 1". Proof questions show "Proved". About 20 questions (graph and sketch questions) still say "See the solution." because they have no final value.

DPP viewer: some questions looked far too large. Fractions in exponents with a minus sign (for example the power minus 1/2 or minus 2/3) are now small, nested brackets are no longer stretched, and short fractions such as 1/a or 1/a squared inside a line of text stay text size. The same exponent fix applies in the Question Bank.

DPP and test viewer: lettered parts such as (ii), (iv) and (v) now keep their formula on the same line as the label, like (i) and (iii), with space between the lines. Fractions in exponents (for example x to the power 2/3) are now small, as they should be. The same exponent fix applies in the Question Bank.
DPP builder: new "Question type" filter (MCQ, MSQ, Numerical, Subjective, Comprehension, Matching) just above the Out-of-syllabus option. Leave it blank to use every type.
Question counts page: Non-PYQ now sits next to PYQs at the top, and the tiles fill the full width on phones.
On phones the chart icon (Question bank numbers menu) is now in the header next to Login, as on computers. The "Question bank numbers" list and "All Math chapters" are removed from the phone menu.
Question counts, Chapter-wise Count and Chapter Weightage pages: a new block "Want to know more, in depth?" with a Purchase Premium button.
Home page: fewer headings (28 down to 19; the card and step titles are plain text now), and the Dashboard icon has a text label for screen readers and search engines.
Exam guide pages now link to the official exam websites (NTA, JEE Advanced, UPSC, KEA, IISER, JoSAA).

New chart icon in the header of every public page (next to the Dashboard icon) with four public pages: Mathematics Bank: Question Counts, Chapter-wise Count, Syllabus Priority and Chapter Weightage. They show counts only, no questions.
Chapter Weightage lets you choose the exam (JEE Main or JEE Advanced), the period (since 2013, last 10 or 5 years) and the sort order.
The "Share this page" box is now at the top of the sidebar on every public page.
On exam guide pages the button "Practise <Exam> math questions" is now a green "<Exam> math analysis" button.

The "Practise this free" box at the bottom of every public page is replaced by "Recommended Reading": four page cards (for example the exam guide, the exam's questions, Syllabus priority and the chapter list) that suit the page you are on.
Exam guide pages: narrow first columns (#, Step, Day) are now narrow, so tables use the space better.
The "Know more" box on exam pages now has its own green colour and a white book button, so it no longer looks like a Login button.

New exam guide pages for all 7 exams (for example unkganit.com/exams/jee-main/about/): paper pattern, question counts, candidate numbers, cutoffs, fees, seats and reservation, top colleges and the step-by-step timeline, in tables.
Each exam page has a new "Know more" button that opens its exam guide.
Exam pages: the main heading is now "<Exam>: Math PYQs, DPPs Analysis" (for example "JEE Main: Math PYQs, DPPs Analysis") on all 7 exams.
Home page: fixed a small white gap (about 8 pixels) around the page, so the header and the blue top section now reach the edges of the browser window.
Exam pages: the year-wise table now lists one year per row (newest first) with the number of questions and their L1 / L2 / L3 levels, with a total row. The same table is on each exam chapter page.
Exam pages now say which papers the counts are based on (for example, KCET: 10 years, 2017–2026, 10 papers, 600 questions).

The public home page is now the main address: unkganit.com. The dashboard now opens at unkganit.com/dashboard. After you sign in you land on the dashboard; the Home icon in the dashboard takes you back to the home page.
Old shared test links (unkganit.com/#/t/...) and Google sign-in returns still work: they are forwarded to the dashboard automatically.
The home page no longer loads the dashboard code, so it opens faster.
All public pages now say "Math" (not "Maths" or "JEE Maths"): chapter, exam, About, Contact, FAQ and menu texts. Web addresses are unchanged.
Home page title is now "Math Question Bank, PYQs, DPPs | अंक-IT", and the main heading, description and text under it say math for all exams (JEE, KCET, NDA, IAT), not JEE only.

Home page SEO: shorter title (Mathematics Dashboard: JEE Maths Practice), the heading and the text under it now use the same key words, 40 fewer headings (chapter and exam cards are no longer headings), no repeated heading or link texts, short link texts (a whole card is still clickable), and descriptive alt text on every image.

Share icons on every public page (sidebar) and in the home page footer: WhatsApp, Reddit, Discord, Instagram and Print, plus one button that opens more networks (Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads, Snapchat, Telegram, Email, Copy link). Discord and Instagram copy the link and open the app. Printing a page now prints only its content.
New footer description.
Home page carousel: no more empty space while a screen loads (it shows a loading placeholder and loads every screen once you reach it), and the pause button now looks right.
Login: no role is pre-selected any more (the choice is saved once and cannot be changed later), the pop-up keeps keyboard focus inside it and returns it when closed.
If the dashboard does not open within 8 seconds, returning users now see a message with Try again and Go to the home page, instead of "Loading…" forever.
The light-background logo is now used on DPP and PYQ sheets and their PDFs.
Home page: "11,000+ full solutions" is replaced by the number of Non-PYQ practice questions in the bank; the questions count now reads 16,000+ everywhere.
Exam pages state how many questions are in the 24 syllabus chapters and how many in out-of-syllabus chapters; the Syllabus Priority page explains its count.
Home page screenshots load only when needed; the carousel has a pause button, proper tab roles and larger dots.
New About and Contact pages, a custom 404 page, a skip-to-content link, larger breadcrumb links, and shorter page titles and descriptions for search results.
Dashboard on tablets: the logo no longer touches the tabs.
Hovering your name icon now opens the account menu on the home page and in the dashboard too, the same as on the other pages (before, it only opened on the other pages).
The account menu on the home page now updates as soon as the dashboard knows your plan, so it never shows an old copy.
Chapter pages now say "Maths" instead of "JEE Maths" (they cover every exam) and live at /maths/…; the old /jee-maths/… addresses forward to them.
Chapter pages: the year-wise trend now covers every exam (JEE Main, JEE Advanced, KCET, NDA, IAT and the older IIT-JEE and AIEEE) in one compact colour strip instead of a long table.
Question levels (L1 / L2 / L3) are shown in the subtopic, topic and exam tables.
Exam pages: the blue bars are replaced by a small dot graph of the last five years, like the dashboard's Syllabus Priority; year-wise tables are now compact strips.
The real exam icons are used everywhere (menu, home, exam pages).
New public Syllabus Priority page, with a Syllabus Priority button in the sidebar of every page.
Signed in, the header on every public page now shows a Dashboard icon and your name icon; hovering the name icon opens the same account menu as in the dashboard.
Exams is now the first item in the menu. Hover opens the exam list on a computer (it no longer closes as you move the pointer down), a tap opens it on a phone, and each exam has its own logo badge.
On phones the menu collapses "Exams" until you tap it, and it closes when you tap anywhere else.

Every exam page now has a clear table: who conducts the exam, what it is for, who can appear, the mode, how often it is held and what the maths paper looks like. The Exams page compares all exams side by side.
Links on an exam page now open that exam only: for example NDA → Probability shows only NDA's Probability topics and years. Chapter pages show a "Questions by exam" table.
The dashboard showcase on the home page is now a swipeable carousel with arrows, tabs and dots, and has two new screens: Handouts and the real online test window.
A sidebar on every inner page (Login/Dashboard, exams, popular chapters, contact).
New logo for white backgrounds in the header and the Login pop-up.
Login now opens as a pop-up on every public page (chapters, exams, About and others) instead of sending you to the home page. The pop-up box is wider, and the staff sentence is removed from it.

New Exams menu in the top bar with JEE Main, JEE Advanced, IIT-JEE, AIEEE, KCET, NDA and IAT: question counts, years and papers for each, with a page per exam showing chapter-wise and year-wise counts.
Real screens from the dashboard (Question Bank, DPP Builder, PYQ papers, Must Solve) on the home page, in the hero and in a tabbed showcase.
Plans now have a Student / Teacher switch with the right price and features for each.

Create Test, Questions step: Chapters is now a multi-select with a search box, and long chapter names stay inside the sidebar.

Create Test on a PC: in step 1 the two cards (Who is this test for? and Time and marking) sit side by side; in step 2 the filters are in a left sidebar with the questions on the right; in step 3 the Save bar sits right under the Review box, with your selected questions below it.
Create Test: the page is wider and keeps a fixed width. It no longer changes size when you click a filter, a card or a step.

Create Test is wider, and the list of selected questions now scrolls with the page, one compact line per question, instead of in its own small scrolling box.

Create Test is now three simple steps: 1 Details (title, class, stream, time and marking), 2 Questions (search and chapter first, the other filters under 'More filters'), 3 Review and save (a summary and your question list). Sign-in screen: the logo now uses dark letters, so it is readable on the white background.

New 'Fit to screen' button that shows the whole page at once. The tool order is now: fit to screen, full screen, download, share.
Handouts: pressing View on another handout while one is open now replaces the handout in the left half, instead of opening a second one on top.
Handout viewer: tidied the toolbar (the page-number box is small again, and the tools sit in a neat second row when the handout is in the half screen), and added a full-screen button.

Handouts: the View and PDF buttons now show only icons (eye, download arrow, and a half-filled circle for the black-and-white print version). Hover to see the name.

Help & Support: Common questions now sit below Contact, and the Free and Premium plans table is wider so its rows no longer wrap into narrow lines.
Logo text is now solid and easy to read: white 'अंक-' and 'MATHEMATICS' with cyan 'IT' on the dark top bar, and navy and blue on white pages and downloads.

The logo now has a transparent background and is a little larger in the top bar. The Word and PowerPoint downloads also say 'अंक-IT'.

New logo and site icon: the new अंक-IT Mathematics logo is now on the sign-in page, the dashboard header, handouts and the PDF, Word and PowerPoint downloads. The browser-tab and phone home-screen icon is the new symbol from the logo.

"Not Working" teachers no longer wait for approval: choosing Not Working (or moving to it) is approved at once, because no student can be in it. They are normal teachers in every other way.
Tests made by Not Working teachers are open to any student who has the test link (their own school approved, class and stream matching). They do not appear in every student's Available tests.

School list: "Not Working" is a built-in choice for teachers who are not at any school right now. It is always the last school in the list for teachers and is never offered to students (the server refuses it for students, and no student can be added to it). It cannot be renamed or deleted.
Boxes with a school picker (Edit teacher, Add a teacher, ...) are bigger, so the whole school list opens inside the box.

Add a student: the Student ID box appears only when Avanti student is ticked.

Approvals → Schools: the admin can rename a school everywhere, merge two schools (rename one to the other's name) or delete a school that has no students on the student list.

Downloads: Word, PowerPoint, sharing and copying are for the admin only (the server sends that code only to the admin). Premium members get PDF downloads and printing. Free accounts view only. Handouts are part of Premium.

Tests: correct answers in a report appear 3 hours after the student started (teachers see them at once). Test questions no longer carry question-bank numbers, so they cannot be looked up.
Teachers' chat: messages are saved by the server with the sender's real name (nobody can pose as someone else), with a limit on how fast messages can be sent; they are deleted after 24 hours.
Staff question flags are now shared through the database. Fixed: a page that was still loading could replace the page you had just opened.
All libraries (KaTeX, PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel readers) are served from this website, and a strict browser security policy blocks code from other sites. Old unused copies of files were removed.
